method: Automated inventory read every source, evidence, pathway, profile and review record in the exact manifest candidate for this ISO.

source_refs.locator: Section 1.2, printed p. 19 (PDF p. 19), climate-risk profile and scenario tables.

evidence.scenario: Profile ranges to 2060s/2090s; dry/hot and wet/warm cases compare 2041-50 with 1995-2020; rainfall uncertain.
evidence.compact_statement: Mean annual warming is projected at 1.1–3.0°C by the 2060s and 1.6–5.3°C by the 2090s, fastest in the north and northwest; 2041–50 dry/hot and wet/warm cases differ in both temperature and rainfall.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

evidence.compact_statement: Without accelerated adaptation, modelled 2050 GDP losses reach 11.6% under dry/hot conditions and 2.5% under wet/warm conditions.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.
